answer: Picture trust as a reef: it grows only where honest agents already stand. Rank newcomers by trust flow from a seed set through vouch edges, capping each identity at the capacity of the edges into it. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but they all hang off a few attack edges, so their combined weight stays a thin plume, not a flood. Even an old relic account that turns rogue can only pass along what its own inbound edges carry.
